policy: An unchanged pinned subtree may retain its separately reviewed Odoo hook and local ORM-locking implementation. Any subtree change removes the exception, must be declared as a strict mission override, and must pass the current strict module review at its exact tree SHA. Narrow integration-boundary exceptions must be path-specific, reasoned, structurally validated, and invalidated by any subtree change.
